svg.title: How to contribute
svg.desc: Six steps: 1 file a lesson, 2 quarantine check, 3 rewritten in our words, never pasted, 4 three projects confirm, 5 one in, one out under a 250-line cap, 6 credit. A good lesson has a real failure with numbers, a rule of one or two lines, and no names, paths or secrets.
